title: Fatty Acid Analysis of Sponge Samples
author: Anna de Kluijver
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bhnpj5dn

steps.title: Prepare P‑buffer solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 8.7 g K₂HPO₄ in 1 L milli‑Q water in a 1 L glass bottle, adjust pH to 7‑9 with 1 M HCl and verify with pH paper.

steps.title: Prepare 0.2 M methanolic NaOH
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.08 g CH₃NaO in 100 mL methanol (MeOH) to obtain a 0.2 M methanolic NaOH solution.

steps.title: Prepare 1 M acetic acid
steps.instruction: Add 5.742 mL glacial acetic acid (17.416 M) to 25 mL milli‑Q water, then fill to 100 mL with milli‑Q in a 100 mL volumetric flask.

steps.title: Prepare Bligh‑and‑Dyer extraction mix
steps.instruction: Mix methanol, dichloromethane (DCM) and P‑buffer in a 2:1:0.8 (v/v/v) ratio; e.g., 250 mL MeOH, 125 mL DCM and 100 mL P‑buffer in a 500 mL Erlenmeyer flask with a glass stopper.

steps.title: Prepare fatty‑acid standards
steps.instruction: Make two 100× stocks: dissolve 20 mg C19:0 FAME in 2 mL hexane and 20 µL C12:0 FAME in 2 mL hexane.

steps.title: Activate silica gel
steps.instruction: Heat silica gel at 120 °C for at least 2 h, then allow to cool; store in a closed bottle for up to 3 days.

steps.title: Pack silica column
steps.instruction: Insert a ball of pre‑extracted cotton‑wool into the tip of a 10 mL glass pipette, add ~0.5 g activated silica on top (≈3 cm length), store the column in a DCM‑filled cylinder, and tap gently to remove air bubbles.

steps.title: Weigh dried sponge sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 30–50 mg dried sponge into a Kimax® centrifuge tube (double amount if both lipid‑class and total‑lipid analyses are required).

steps.title: Add BDE mix and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 28.5 mL Bligh‑and‑Dyer extraction (BDE) mix, close the lid, and shake or vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Ultrasonic extraction for 10 min
steps.instruction: Place the tube in an ultrasonic bath for 00:10:00 (10 minutes).

steps.title: Add DCM and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 mL dichloromethane (DCM), close the lid, and shake/vortex.

steps.title: Shake on horizontal shaker for 3 h
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a horizontal roller shaker for a minimum of 03:00:00 (3 hours); ensure lids remain tightly closed.

steps.title: Add P‑buffer and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 7.5 mL P‑buffer, close the lid, and shake/vortex.

steps.title: Separate phases by centrifuge or freezer
steps.instruction: Allow the layers to separate either by leaving the tubes overnight in a freezer or by gentle centrifugation at 170 × g for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect bottom DCM layer
steps.instruction: Using a Pasteur pipette or glass syringe, collect the bottom DCM layer into a 50 mL glass vial; avoid the interphase, take a small air bubble to clean the tip, and clean the syringe between samples with DCM:methanol (1:1).

steps.title: Second DCM extraction and collection
steps.instruction: Add another 7.5 mL DCM, repeat phase separation (centrifuge or freezer), and collect the DCM layer into the same vial.

steps.title: Dry extracts under N₂ at 30 °C
steps.instruction: Dry the combined DCM extracts completely under a gentle nitrogen stream in a turbovap set to 30 °C, ≤5 psi (start with 1–2 psi).

steps.title: Redissolve residue and dry at 26 °C
steps.instruction: Transfer the dried residue to a pre‑weighed 4 mL vial, add approximately 1 mL DCM:MeOH (1:1), then dry in a Flexivap at 26 °C under a gentle N₂ stream.

steps.title: Weigh vial to determine lipid yield
steps.instruction: Weigh the vial to obtain total lipid mass relative to the sponge dry weight; the Bligh‑and‑Dyer extract is now ready.

steps.title: Optional residue clean‑up (if needed)
steps.instruction: If residue remains, clean it by passing DCM:MeOH (1:1) through a Pasteur pipette containing pre‑extracted cotton‑wool.

steps.title: Wash column with DCM
steps.instruction: Place the prepared silica column in a holder, position a collection vial or beaker underneath, and wash the column with DCM.

steps.title: Load sample onto silica column
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried lipid extract in 0.5 mL DCM and add the solution to the top of the column.

steps.title: Collect neutral lipid fraction
steps.instruction: Do not disturb the column; collect the neutral lipid fraction that elutes first into a 10 mL vial (or discard as waste).

steps.title: Elute glycolipids with acetone
steps.instruction: Elute the glycolipid fraction with 7 mL acetone (picograde pestinorm) into a 10 mL vial (or discard).

steps.title: Elute phospholipids with MeOH
steps.instruction: Elute the phospholipid fraction with 15 mL methanol into a 20 mL glass vial for further analysis.

steps.title: Dry phospholipid fraction at 30 °C
steps.instruction: Dry the MeOH fraction in a turbovap at 30 °C, ≤5 psi (start with 1–2 psi) until completely dry.

steps.title: Add reagents for methylation
steps.instruction: To the dried sample add 1 mL MeOH:toluene (1:1 v/v), then 1 mL 0.2 M methanolic NaOH, and finally 50 µL 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ C19:0 FAME standard (using a glass syringe/pipette).

steps.title: Incubate methylation at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 00:15:00 (15 minutes) in an oven.

steps.title: Quench reaction with hexane, acid, water
steps.instruction: Stop methylation by adding 2 mL hexane, 0.3 mL 1 M acetic acid, and 2 mL milli‑Q water (add exactly with a pipette).

steps.title: Mix and separate phases
steps.instruction: Vortex or shake vigorously, then allow the phases to separate; the upper hexane layer should become clear.

steps.title: Collect upper hexane layer
steps.instruction: Using a Pasteur pipette, collect the upper hexane layer into a 10 mL glass vial, avoiding any water layer.

steps.title: Repeat hexane extraction twice
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL hexane again, vortex, separate, and collect the upper layer into the same vial; repeat this step a second time for a total of three hexane extracts.

steps.title: Add internal standard and transfer to GC vials
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL C12:0 FAME and approximately 100 µL hexane or ethyl acetate, then transfer the final extract into GC analysis vials.

steps.title: Store GC vials at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Store the GC vials at –20 °C until analysis; hexane and ethyl acetate give comparable results, but ensure C12:0 FAME is in the same solvent as the sample.

steps.title: Add DCM and evaporate final extract
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL dichloromethane to the vial and evaporate again to dryness before GC injection.
